hotels.title: South Coast NSW Kiama Harbourside Hotel with Restaurant
hotels.description: Escape to harbourside charm at this serene hotel, ideally located in the picturesque seaside town of Kiama. This elegant retreat offers beautifully appointed rooms and a state-of-the-art fitness centre. Plus, tuck into a mouth-watering selection of local produce at Yves bar and bistro as you look out over the Pacific Ocean. Just a stone's throw away, you'll find the Kiama Blowhole, a natural spectacle that's a must-visit, and the thrilling Jamberoo Action Park. Savour the region's fresh seafood at local eateries, explore the stunning Minnamurra Rainforest, or stroll along the Kiama Coastal Walk for breathtaking ocean views.

hotels.title: Southern NSW Coastal Escape near Kiama Harbour with Seaside Restaurant & Daily Breakfast
hotels.description: Experience the allure of New South Wales’ southern coast with a stay at this charming seaside retreat on Kiama Harbour, overlooking the Pacific Ocean. Nestled in a region where natural beauty meets vibrant local life, Kiama is a haven for outdoor enthusiasts and those who appreciate the finer things in life. Savour waterfront dining at the onsite Yves Social, featuring a gourmet dinner menu, or indulge in daily breakfast at The Quarry Room. Maintain your routine at the fitness centre and admire the stunning architecture of the heritage-listed bluestone building on the hotel grounds. Discover the local scene at the Kiama Seaside Markets, explore pristine beaches, witness the impressive Kiama Blowhole or enjoy panoramic views from Saddleback Mountain.
